summary: FORELDRERÅDET OG FAU VED EIDE BARNESKOLE (org. no. 916 197 454) is an association (FLI) based in Hustadvika, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2015-11-06. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 94.992 (Aktiviteter i andre medlemsorganisasjoner ellers); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Birger Laugsand.
